title: MapaSUS — Hospitais de Referência do SUS
description: Public, free REST API that normalises and republishes Brazilian Ministry of Health hospital data (animais peçonhentos vertical in production; doenças raras and oncologia in development), built on a serverless architecture with an LLM-based extraction pipeline (Gemini → Groq → Tesseract fallback chain) that bridges the gap between government PDF publications and machine-readable health-system data.
